name:
Wario Land:
Super Mario Land 3
description:
Witness Wario’s world-famous debut as a playable character, in the first game to bear the Wario Land name.

In Wario Land: Super Mario Land 3, the greedy treasure seeker is on a quest to Kitchen Island where he plans to steal the pirates’ booty, to help him build a castle bigger than Mario’s.

Unlike Mario, Wario has some tough moves at his disposal, like the body slam, and he can don different magic hats to turn him into Jet Wario, Bull Wario and even Dragon Wario!

본 소프트웨어를 사용하기 전에 HOME 메뉴의「안전을 위한 주의사항」을 선택하여 내용을 확인해 주십시오.
여기에는 고객님의 건강와 안전을 위한 중요한 내용이 기재되어 있습니다.
또한 본체의 사용설명서도 함께 읽어 주십시오.
